messages:
tasha: hi team, weird one  our backyard contractor apparently hit the telecom line digging for a new fence. internet is kaput for most of the block . crew said 90min but could be longer. posting from phone hotspot.
devon: yikes. pics? did they at least plant a shrub afterwards? :joy:
tasha: lol yes photo attached: <https://files.redwood.ai/backyard-dig.jpg|backyard-dig.jpg>
rui: classic. hope the cable folks bring snacks. on the bright side, instant forced break for Zoom fatigue.
oliver: if anyone needs a temporary remote meeting room, i've got a spare desk at the co-working place 2 miles away. can host up to 2 folks. ping me.
tasha: appreciate it! i might grab a coffee and hotspot there if repair drags.
devon: for folks on mac/android, remember: Settings > Personal Hotspot OR iPhone: Settings > Cellular > Personal Hotspot. Android: Settings > Network & Internet > Hotspot & tethering.
infra-bot: Incident logged: OUTAGE-1802345678  Assigned to: oncall-network. Estimated restore: 90 minutes. Reporter: tasha.
rui: small PSA: carrier hotspots sometimes throttle. if you need stable for an interview or demo, consider moving to oliver's spot or the library.
tasha: thanks all. will update when the line is fixed. also awarding kudos to the repair tech who climbed a fence like a ninja
